as_told.title: Pentagon 'super user' briefing on compartmented programs had nothing about UFOs

plain: A former research director at the National Security Agency, the US spy agency that intercepts communications, says he never saw any program to take apart and copy recovered UFOs. Eric Haseltine says he "had access to a whole lot of stuff" and once, as a "super user," sat through a full day of briefings on the Pentagon's walled-off secret programs, "like Clockwork Orange where they clamped open my eyelids," and "there was nothing about UFOs in there." He tells it to weigh against claims that such programs are hidden inside the government.
